chose: A snip and a some-ui.screens/1 screen (RR31) are one family, a photographed screen of the app with its named parts boxed. The snip record moves into @some-ui/video-render beside the screen record and gains the two facts a screen has that it lacked: its scale, and the parts the page names (data-region), measured on the web walk and none on the APK's device screenshots. A scene shows a snip by one new member of the cut list's picture union, {kind: snip, id, at}, and resolveSnips draws it with what the renderer already has: a still of the whole screen, or the screen-zoom composition over the snip read as a screen (snipScreen). No second scene kind, renderer path or screen schema.
options: one family: a snip resolves to a still or a zoom over a screen, the record beside screens/1
a snip scene kind of its own, drawn by its own renderer path
two records, snips/1 and screens/1, with no mapping between them
